Compare the fleet, pick the boat that fits your crew, and we'll handle Lake Michigan. Our flagship boat, built for 12 of your closest crew. services.name: Tiki Pontoon
services.desc: Bring 11 friends, your cooler, and whatever’s going on the grill. Your captain handles Lake Michigan, the Chicago skyline does the rest. Tiki Pontoon is our flagship boat, a 12 passenger private pontoon built for the kind of trip you don't want to end. Bring your crew, your cooler, and something for the grill. The waterslide handles the kids, the lily pad and floaties handle the lake, and a clean onboard restroom means you can stay out longer. This is the boat for family outings, bachelorette parties, birthday parties, and private corporate events.
